commands.command: mkdir ./immich-app && cd ./immich-app && wget -O docker-compose.yml https://github.com/immich-app/immich/releases/latest/download/docker-compose.yml && wget -O .env https://github.com/immich-app/immich/releases/latest/download/example.env && docker compose up -d

note: Commands are from the official Docker Compose install page; the page says to edit .env (UPLOAD_LOCATION, DB_PASSWORD, TZ) before starting, and does not mention sudo.
